author: Pallas, 1811
habitat: 서해와 남해의 섬, 바닷가의 트인 곳

months.note: 봄에는 4월 초~5월 하순에 비교적 많이 지나가고, 가을에는 9월 중순~10월 중순에 드물게 지나간다.

summary: 봄과 가을에 주로 서해의 섬을 거쳐 가는 드문 나그네새로, 해마다 수십 마리가 기록된다. 2003년 4월 어청도에서 처음 사진으로 기록되었고, 이후 해마다 봄에는 4월 초~5월 하순, 가을에는 9월 중순~10월 중순에 관찰된다. 전깃줄에 앉아 쉬다가 건물 지붕 밑에서 잠을 자기도 하며, 다른 제비처럼 날면서 날벌레를 잡는다. 시베리아 동부와 몽골 북부, 중국 북동부에서 번식하고 동남아시아에서 겨울을 난다.

points.en: large white rump patch extending onto the uppertail coverts
forked black tail, deeper than Asian House Martin's

young: 어린새는 어른새보다 윗면이 칙칙한 갈색을 띠고 푸른 광택이 적으며 꼬리가 짧다. 가슴과 옆구리, 아래꼬리 쪽이 갈색 기로 지저분해 보이고, 위꼬리덮깃에 검은 깃심이 있어 허리의 흰 부분이 덜 깨끗하다.

similar.how: 흰털발제비는 허리의 흰 부분이 작아 위꼬리덮깃까지 이어지지 않고, 가슴과 옆구리에 잿빛 기가 돌아 아랫면이 덜 깨끗하다.

art.subject: Siberian House Martin (Delichon lagopodum), adult (sexes alike), as seen in Korea on spring passage in May: crown, nape, mantle and scapulars glossy blue-black; wings and tail black; a large, pure white rump patch extending onto the uppertail coverts; chin, throat, underparts and undertail coverts pure white, cleanly divided from the dark head below the eye; tail clearly forked without streamers. Bill tiny and black; dark eye; legs and toes covered in white feathers.
art.pose: hawking insects in flight over a headland with other swallows
art.scene: rocky headland on a Korean offshore island in May, open sky and sea behind; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched on a wire: compact martin with glossy blue-black crown, nape and back, the dark reaching only just below the eye, clean white chin, throat and underparts, black wings, white rump showing above the forked black tail, tiny black bill, short white-feathered legs

adult, in flight seen squarely from above: broad-based triangular wings spread straight out to the sides to their full span, glossy blue-black head and back, blackish wings, large pure white rump patch extending onto the uppertail coverts, forked black tail

adult, in flight seen squarely from below: white chin, throat, breast and belly, dark grey-brown underwing coverts and flight feathers, forked black tail, white-feathered feet tucked against the belly
art.build: Small, compact martin, a little smaller and much shorter-tailed than a Barn Swallow, with broad-based triangular wings. Bill tiny and black. Legs short and feathered white to the toes. Tail black, clearly forked but without streamers. In flight the extensive white rump and white underparts contrast strongly with the glossy blue-black upperparts, while the underwing coverts are dark grey-brown like the flight feathers, not white.
avoid: Do not paint dingy greyish underparts and a small rump with a shallow notch; that is Asian House Martin (Delichon dasypus).
Do not paint tail streamers or a red throat (Barn Swallow).
Do not paint brown upperparts and a breast band (Sand Martin, Riparia riparia).
Do not paint bare dark toes; the feet are feathered white.
